The sentiment trend described in the text indicates a clear negative shift. Initially, the product was likely received with more optimism, but one month post-release, frustration has grown due to unresolved software issues and a perceived lack of timely updates. This has led to a surge in negative reviews that are now outnumbering positive ones, signaling a deteriorating reputation and a worrying trajectory for the company.

Regarding the primary material of a candle, it is typically made of wax. Common types of wax include paraffin wax (derived from petroleum), beeswax (produced by honey bees), soy wax (made from soybean oil), and palm wax. The wax serves as the fuel source that melts and is drawn up the wick to sustain the flame.
